column1: # mapping_set_title: DDI Codebook (common core, 2.5 ∩ 1.2.2) to CDIF

# mapping_set_description: Shared literal-field crosswalk for the DDI Codebook elements common to both 2.5 and 1.2.2 (identical XPath under stdyDscr/fileDscr/dataDscr/docDscr). Imported by ddi25-to-cdif and ddi122-to-cdif via `sssom merge`.
#   Comprehensive worksheet, COMMON CORE: every literal-valued element present in
#   BOTH DDI Codebook 2.5 and 1.2.2 at the same path, mapped to CDIF where a target
#   exists, else blank object_id/predicate for review. subject_id uses the
#   version-neutral `ddicb:` prefix. To get a complete single-version crosswalk,
#   merge this set with the version extras, e.g.:
#   are omitted; only data-bearing attributes that map are kept (var/@name, varFormat/@type).
